Tooltip_OMHTT_BedSpikes: Floor spikes. Walk safely; running risks scratches and sprinting risks a fall. Repair: one plank and a hammer, 4 seconds. Place/pick up: 2 seconds; condition retained.
Tooltip_OMHTT_PortableBarrier: Right-click the crafted item and choose Place Trap. Placement consumes one finished barrier and grants no XP.
Tooltip_OMHTT_BarrierPack: Contains five Spike Barriers. Unpack in the Crafting menu. Bundled encumbrance is reduced by 67 percent.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ReinforcedBarrier: Right-click the crafted item and choose Place Trap.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ReinforcedPack: Five reinforced barriers. 67 percent less weight.
Tooltip_OMHTT_TurretBase: Holds a head, ammo, modules and a battery.
Tooltip_OMHTT_PotatoHead: Install in a turret base. Uses potatoes and power.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleStorage: Storage prototype. Module effects are not enabled yet.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleFiring: Fires forward; Detection adds automatic aiming.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleCapacity: Adds ammo capacity and module slots.
Tooltip_OMHTT_Barbs: Attach to a wall, fence, door or window. Door barbs follow the leaf; window barbs stay on the frame. Slows and damages zombies touching the exposed side. Walk safely; running risks scratches and sprinting risks a fall.
Tooltip_OMHTT_FiringImprovised: Automatic firing with a chance to misfire.
Tooltip_OMHTT_CapacityImprovised: Adds head-specific ammo storage and 2 module slots.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ConcertinaWire: Linked 1x2 freestanding wire. Slows and damages zombies during contact; overlapping wire and panels do not stack. 50 shared durability, one wear per damaging activation. Walk safely; running risks scratches and sprinting risks a fall.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleFragment: Five damaging fragments at the bullet endpoint.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleFiringEnhanced: Automatic firing at full firearm cadence.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleDetectionEnhanced: 3x turning speed and faster target detection.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModulePiercing: Shots pass through zombies, retaining 70%% damage.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleInitialBlow: Bonus damage against targets at 90%% HP or higher.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleExecute: Finishes hit targets at 10%% HP or less.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleImpact: First shot after reload has a 60%% stagger chance.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleSynergy: Secondary effects trigger module benefits. Martyrdom chains once at 50%% damage.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleMartyrdom: Kills cause a delayed damaging pop.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModulePack: Contains three random modules. Duplicates possible.
Tooltip_OMHTT_BallistaHead: Launches spears. Install in a turret base.
Tooltip_OMHTT_RotaryBatHead: Powered front and rear sweeps. Add 360 for full rotation.
Tooltip_OMHTT_RotaryBladesHead: Powered front and rear sweeps. Add 360 for full rotation.
Tooltip_OMHTT_LobberHead: Launches grenades with a fuse after landing.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ScrapshotHead: Fires a wide fan of metal fragments.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleLure: Attracts zombies with an adjustable sound.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleVoid: Stores ammunition without weight. Stored ammunition cannot be withdrawn.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleSiphon: Kills have a 45%% chance to restore 2x the shot's battery cost.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleGrid: Enables mains and generator power. Falls back to batteries. Does not recharge batteries.
